02369 Chowtham {kho-thawm'}

與02368同; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Hotham 1, Hothan 1; 2

何坦 = "封印"

1) 亞設支派的人 (#代上 7:32|)
2) 大衛的兩名大能勇士的父親 (#代上 11:44|)
record.edic_text:
02369 Chowtham {kho-thawm'}

the same as 02368;; n pr m

AV - Hotham 1, Hothan 1; 2

Hotham = "seal"
1) a man of Asher, son of Heber, of the family of Beriah
2) father of two of David's mighty warriors
